ryans.name: Ryan Dunwoody
ryans.title: Hardware engineer; co-creator of pi-top; Powerhouse founder
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Dunwoody** (born 1990 or 1991) is a British hardware engineer and entrepreneur based in Shenzhen, China [3][6]. With Jesse Lozano he co-created **pi-top**, a Raspberry Pi laptop kit that Guinness World Records lists as the first 3D-printed laptop, dated 9 November 2014 [1]. He later founded the motor-control company Motormaster and, in 2025, **Powerhouse Engineering**, a Shenzhen company that offers hardware startups engineering, prototyping and manufacturing support [6][7].
known_for: Co-creating pi-top, Guinness World Records' first 3D-printed laptop
